card.name: Odd punctuation inside units and pronunciations
card.fires_on: Punctuation or symbol pieces in the middle of a compound: a separator before a table cell, the x in a size like 9x12, an asterisk in a unit like AU*/mL, or a hyphen or syllable in a pronunciation guide.

modes.label: Pronunciation guides
modes.description: Syllables or hyphens inside a spelled-out pronunciation of a medical term.
modes.example: This is called a subcutaneous (sub-kyu-TAY-<<nee>>-us) injection.

modes.label: Units and footnote marks
modes.description: Asterisks or slashes inside units or after table values, marking footnotes or ratios.

modes.label: Table and size separators
modes.description: A pipe or quote-x symbol joining parts of a table row or a dimension.

card.plain: It fires on small symbols and hyphens inside measurements, footnotes and pronunciation guides.
